page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Compute resources include 4 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 2 physical cores utilizing hyper-threading. The CPU configuration features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a 48 MB L3 cache, alongside instruction support for AVX-512 and hardware cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI. The instance is provisioned with 32 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. It does not bundle local storage, requiring external block volumes, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps without integrated GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent mid-tier single-threaded compute capability paired with expected throughput ceilings across parallel workloads. The system achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1557.0 and a stress-ng single-core result of 1859.69. Single-threaded data tasks perform steadily, reaching 27.75 GB/sec in gzip compression and 3604.11 on the PassMark CPU encryption evaluation. In contrast, multi-threaded benchmarks reflect the two-core physical boundary, yielding a Geekbench multi-core score of 3323.0, a PassMark CPU score of 5875.9, and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 20.85 GB/sec. Large-block uncached memory benchmarks show 29.19 GB/sec read and 25.02 GB/sec write bandwidth, supporting 3.93 million Redis SET operations per second.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance balances cost efficiency by directing resources toward capacity rather than excess CPU scaling. The 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio allows applications requiring high working-set footprints to avoid overpaying for unnecessary compute cores. Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe storage, moderate network throughput, and lower parallel computing capacity. The instance is primarily suited for in-memory caching tiers such as Redis or Memcached, lightweight transactional database engines, session state repositories, and memory-constrained microservices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor, powered by a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor with x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores via symmetric multithreading, coupled with 32 GB of system memory, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. It features 48 MB of L3 cache, hardware cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA extensions, and AVX-512 vector support. The configuration includes no local storage, requiring network-attached volumes, and provides a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth with zero GPU acceleration. Benchmark profiles indicate solid mid-tier single-threaded performance across computational and cryptographic tasks, though multi-threaded throughput and memory bandwidth scale lower due to the 2-core boundary. Given its dense memory profile relative to computing resources, this instance provides effective hardware utilization for in-memory key-value caching, Redis deployments, lightweight relational databases, and background memory-bound batch workers.
